title: 2017 LLVM Developers’ Meeting: “Implementing Swift Generics ”
summary: Swift compiler engineers explain how Swift implements generics using dictionary-passing with reified type metadata. They compare it with Java-style uniform representation and C++ or Rust monomorphization.
why: Recommended as the clearest explanation of how Swift generics compile and how that differs from other languages.

quote.text: there's a very nice talk on how Swift's generics compile.
